comments: We have discussed the organizational structure of our collections and have concluded that this collection is a subcollection to a bigger overarching collection instead of its own collection.

suggestedEntity.name: Stiftung Herbarium Paul Aellen
suggestedEntity.description: The herbarium of the Foundation Paul Aellen, Basel, disbanded in 1973. Most of the collection was incorporated into G as G-PAE and only briefly part of the herbaria of the University of Basel. Aellen's Swiss plants were incorporated into BAS.
suggestedEntity.notes: PAE (220 000 specimens) incorporated in G as G-PAE except Swiss specimens incorporated in BAS.

comments: Jurriaan de Vos, leading curator of BAS and the Herbaria Basel.
